1479-2443-2841-8338.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

339-677-6968-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1284-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least four counters on it.
1284-4687-5479.description:
Activate Viridian Longbow by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte three times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping three lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}{G/U}.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7932.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact or creature card in your graveyard.
6797-6972-7932.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ceti Eel.
When Ceti Eel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ceti Eel enters, it triggers, causing you to mill two cards and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
2079-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

997-2946-4871-6887.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
997-2946-4871-6887.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3532-4928-5078-7753.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2060-4929-5652-7741.description:
Activate Genku by paying {3}{W}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}.
Repeat.
2060-4929-5652-7741.notes: Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego removing counters from Cryptic Trilobite.

1061-4499-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-4499-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking it.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

855-1806-2060-5231-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2281-2511-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-5671-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5671-6620.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size, one of which must be a land card.
250-779-1479-5671-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard a land and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return a land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

3490-6006-6633-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-6633-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2275-3532-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

394-2034-4365-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-2034-4365-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

997-3817-3991.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-851-1270-1308.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1270-1308.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

2445-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Branching Evolution.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2292-2732-6132.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

813-2417-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-2417-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4613-4644-6210.easyPrerequisites:
Neerdiv has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Neerdiv, Devious Diver does not have summoning sickness.
4613-4644-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Neerdiv ability from step 1, untapping it.
Repeat.

2178-2438-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2178-2438-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

647-2457-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

695-2781-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
695-2781-4605.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

101-4872-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Warp and Vampire Charmseeker each turn.
101-4872-6122.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Vampire Charmseeker by paying its mana cost.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Vampire Charmseeker from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-6171.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-6171.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Fearless Fledgling trigger.
Resolve the Fearless Fledgling trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

62-3398-5608.notablePrerequisites:
Radha and Savage Ventmaw do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Radha, Savage Ventmaw or Hellkite Charger.
62-3398-5608.description:
Declare Radha, Savage Ventmaw and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Radha trigger, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

692-1335-4050-4613.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-1335-4050-4613.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Marath's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2048-2707-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1963-3266-3712-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
1963-3266-3712-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kavu Lair and Garruk's Packleader trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

1651-2410-5216.notablePrerequisites:
Iron Myr and Myr Galvanizer do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional Myr artifact creatures.
1651-2410-5216.description:
Activate Iron Myr by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two other Myr artifact creatures you control, untapping Myr Galvanizer.
Repeat.
If you control another Myr that can tap to produce at least {1}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1383-2336-4067.notablePrerequisites: You have no cards in hand.
1383-2336-4067.description:
Activate Phial of Galadriel by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Oath of Lim-Dûl by paying {B}{B}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Phial of Galadriel.
Activate Phial of Galadriel by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Phial of Galadriel.
Repeat.

1765-4050-4124-4772.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Whip Silk enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk' second ability by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

186-1409-1810-2690-4208.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Deadeye Navigator.
The Deadeye Navigator token enters the battlefield, triggering its soulbond ability, pairing it and Ixidron.
Activate Ixidron by paying {U}, blinking it.
All other nontoken creatures you control are turned face-down as Ixidron enters the battlefield.
Ixidron enters the battlefield, triggering the token Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability, repairing Ixidron and the token Deadeye Navigator.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {1}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Kianne, Dean of Substance // Imbraham, Dean of Theory

1636-3155.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}{G}.
You have at least one card in exile with a study counter on it.
1636-3155.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding {5}{G}.
Activate Kianne's second ability by paying {4}{G}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
The Fractal enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1479-1692-1824.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Kodama.
You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation.
1479-1692-1824.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary copy of Kodama.
Cast Acererak by paying {2}{B}.
Acererak enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Kodama and the Kodama token.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama trigger, choosing not to put anything on the battlefield.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and venturing into any dungeon except Tomb of Annihilation.
Resolve the token Kodama trigger, putting Acererak from your hand onto the battlefield.
Acererak enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the nontoken Kodama.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and venturing into any dungeon except Tomb of Annihilation.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama trigger, putting Acererak from your hand onto the battlefield.
Acererak enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the token Kodama.
Repeat from step 5.

2605-3932-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Hope Tender does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Hope Tender.
You control an additional land that can tap for mana.
2605-3932-4222.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} .
Activate your additional land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Hope Tender's last ability by paying {1}, tapping it, and exerting it, untapping Lotus Vale and a land that can tap for mana.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Hope Tender.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
